description: Calculate the cosmic-ray ambient dose equivalent rate H*(10) and effective dose rate E (ICRP 116), in uSv/h, inside an aircraft cabin (0-20 km) or on the ground (0-6 km), for a latitude, longitude and solar activity, and the effective dose of a stay or flight at that place. Uses precomputed PARMA 4.10 tables of the Japan Atomic Energy Agency (US Standard Atmosphere, vertical cut-off rigidity Rc from the PARMA database for the present epoch, A340 reference mass in the aircraft), interpolated log-linearly in altitude and linearly in Rc and W-index. Galactic cosmic rays only, one position and no route integration; for route doses use EXPACS. Give either w_index (0-150) or solar (min for December 2009, max for August 2024).

altitude_km.description: Altitude in km: 0-20 in a cabin, 0-6 on the ground.

w_index.description: Solar modulation W-index, 0 to 150. Supply this or solar.

name: cosmic_dose
title: Cosmic-ray and aviation dose
